name: std::fgetpos
intro: Obtains the file position indicator and the current parse state (if any) for the file stream stream and stores them in the object pointed to by pos. The value stored is only meaningful as the input to std::fsetpos.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
stream

 -

 file stream to examine


 pos

 -

 pointer to a fpos_t object to store the file position indicator to

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: 0 upon success, nonzero value otherwise. Also sets errno on failure.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
